character: Adriatic-coast circuit best known as MotoGP's home in Italy, adapted for cars. Tight, technical layout with a mix of medium-speed corners and few pure straights — demands a well-balanced, agile car.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake hard from the front straight, late apex to open the following sequence
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the technical section that follows

corners.name: Curvone
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry speed through the long radius
corners.trap: Lifting mid-corner kills momentum through this key speed section

corners.name: Quercia
corners.technique: Late apex, patient throttle application on exit
corners.trap: Early throttle causes a slide on the tightening exit

corners.name: Tramonto
corners.type: final-sector corner leading to the last complex
corners.technique: Prioritise a clean, well-placed line to set up the run to the finish
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running wide, compromising the final corners
